def computeProb(i, n):

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:

    n = int(data[0])
    d = float(data[1])
    for i in range(n + 1):
        if computeProb(i, n) + 1e-8 >= d:
            print(i)
            break
